verdict.line: You lose if you trade passively into his Last Rites sustain and let Dark Procession wall you off; you win if you time Counter Strike into his empowered auto and force fights.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks, and Yorick's entire early trade is built around an empowered basic attack — Q (Last Rites). Timing E into that swing voids both the bonus damage and his self-heal in one stun, which is the real reason the measured numbers favor Jax: 51.9% win rate over 1114 games, well above Jax's 49.4% baseline across all top lane games, plus a measured solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.when: E (Mourning Mist) lands and W wall traps you
theirWindow.what: Mourning Mist reduces your armor, damages, slows, and marks you so his summoned units gain move speed chasing you; if Dark Procession's wall is already up behind you, you're stuck eating the full mark duration. Disengage before the wall lands, not after.

yourWindow.when: Yorick commits his Last Rites auto
yourWindow.what: Counter Strike (E) dodges that empowered attack outright and then stuns him and nearby enemies — follow immediately with Leap Strike (Q) and Empower (W) for a full-damage burst while he has no heal and no escape.

powerCurve.note: Both have their core trade tool online
Leap Strike + Empower outburst his melee pattern
R up for both, Maiden rarely active yet
Trinity Force/Sundered Sky spike wins extended fights
Full build shreds him between his 100s R windows

start.why: Highest-performing start (50.6% over 902 games, 63.1% pick) — the extra AD and sustain reward the aggressive Q/W/E trade pattern you're going to run every time his Last Rites swing is dodgeable.

boots.why: Best-performing boots here (52.7% over 857 games, 64.3% pick) — Yorick's damage comes from autos (Last Rites, Mist Walkers), so flat physical reduction blunts exactly what he's throwing at you.

core.why: Empower (W) and Leap Strike (Q) both benefit from the proc damage and mobility, letting you initiate and burst off cooldown rather than waiting on auto-attack resets.
Converts your empowered strikes into sustained healing and burst, which is what the highest win-rate build paths (58.8-72.7% across these games) are built around.
The Trinity Force into Sundered Sky into Death's Dance path hits 72.7% over 55 games — the bleed-and-heal lets you win extended trades even if Last Rites connects once.

situational.when: yorick's maiden of the mist is up and raising walkers, turning skirmishes into numbers fights you need to survive
the game drags past 25 minutes and you need sustained DPS and a slow to punish him through his wall plays
his team stacks hard CC that would otherwise lock you out of your counter strike window

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed stacks directly with Relentless Assault's (R) growing attack speed and every-third-hit bonus damage, so your all-in after an E stun snowballs faster than his sustain can answer.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-played (76.4% pick) and backs up the measured solo-kill advantage you have in this matchup — burn through his Last Rites heal once you land the E stun. Flash+Teleport (52.5% win rate, 19.5% pick) is the alternative if you expect a longer, wave-trading lane instead of early kill attempts.

playing.title: Dodge Last Rites with E
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks; Last Rites is an empowered auto, so timing E into it cancels his bonus damage and his heal in the same stun.

playing.title: Fight before his R is up
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles sits at 160 seconds at rank 1 and never drops below 100 even at max rank — without the Maiden active he has no bonus damage multiplier, so look for fights whenever his ultimate is down.

playing.title: Don't get walled in
playing.detail: Dark Procession summons a destructible wall that blocks movement; watch for him dropping it behind you to cut off your path to tower before you commit to an extended trade.

playing.title: Step out of Mourning Mist
playing.detail: Mourning Mist reduces your armor, damages, slows, and marks you so his summoned units gain move speed chasing the mark — sidestep the throw rather than eating it and fighting through the slow.

playing.title: Leap, then empower the follow-up
playing.detail: Use Leap Strike to close or reposition, then immediately Empower your next attack so it hits Yorick and anything near him for bonus damage.

playing.title: Prime Relentless Assault first
playing.detail: R grants attack speed with every strike and bonus damage every third hit — land a couple of autos on him or a minion before the all-in so the ramp is already rolling when it matters.

playing.title: Push for the early kill
playing.detail: The measured data gives Jax the solo-kill advantage here — your E-stun trade outvalues his healing window before level 6, so look to end the lane rather than scale passively into his wall-and-walker siege.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes here are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning (why the trade works, when to dodge, when to force it) is independent tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Mourning Mist (E) will place Mist Walkers on you. Try to avoid getting hit!
